name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
description: Access, comprehensive financial data and analytics through AI-powered tools. Connect to FactSet global prices, fundamental analysis, earnings estimates, and research insights into Claude, to enhance your financial analysis, earning estimates and investment research with trusted, institutional-quality data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FactSet AI-Ready Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FactSet AI-Ready Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.factset.com/content/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is FactSet AI-Ready Data MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, FactSet AI-Ready Data scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.
